source:
@@U02140@@
If you feel it’s me, then come with me!

@@U02142@@
Out there?

@@U02144@@
Into the open!

@@U02146@@
If the grave’s out there
and death is waiting, then come!
From here to my eternal rest
and not one step beyond—
You're going now?
Oh, 海因里希, if only I could, too!

@@U02148@@
You can!
Just want to!
The door is open.

@@U02150@@
I don’t dare.
There’s no hope for me.
What good is running away?
They're waiting out there to catch me.
It’s miserable having to beg,
and even worse with a guilty conscience!
It’s miserable
wandering around some foreign country.
Besides, they'd catch me in the end.

@@U02152@@
I'll never leave you.

@@U02154@@
Quick! Quick!
Save your poor child!
translation:
@@U02140@@
如果你觉得是我，那就跟我来吧！

@@U02142@@
在那里？

@@U02144@@
进入开放！

@@U02146@@
如果坟墓就在那里
死亡正在等待，那就来吧！
从这里到我永恒的安息
并且没有超出一步——
你现在就走吗？
哦，海因里希，要是我也能就好了！

@@U02148@@
你可以！
只是想要！
门是开着的。

@@U02150@@
我不敢。
我没有希望了。
逃跑有什么好处？
他们正在外面等着抓我。
不得不乞讨是很痛苦的，
更糟糕的是心怀愧疚！
真是惨不忍睹
去一些异国他乡闲逛。
而且，他们最终会抓住我的。

@@U02152@@
我永远不会离开你。

@@U02154@@
快点！快的！
拯救你可怜的孩子！
